mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Gateway Sneak: "Whenever a Gate you control enters, this creature can't be blocked this turn.
# Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card."
# [0]: the landfall event (Scute Swarm) over Gates you control (SUBTYPE_EQ Gate, Circuitous Route's
# Gate); effect: M21 Ghostly Pilferer's verified "This creature can't be blocked this turn."
# [1]: M21 Jeskai Elder's verified combat-damage trigger, the draw mandatory.
gate_enters = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAnd(
            children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.SUBTYPE_EQ, string_value='Gate'),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.PREVENT_EFFECT, {
        'condition': FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
        'duration': DurationEot(),
        'event': DeclareBlockersEvent(
            filter=FAnd(children=()),
            blocked=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
        ),
    }),
)
combat_damage = TriggeredAbility(
    event=DamageDealtEvent(
        amount=QUnbounded(),
        filter=FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_PERMANENT)),
        source=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
        combat=True,
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
)
abilities = [gate_enters, combat_damage, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Whenever a Gate you control enters, this creature can't be blocked this turn.
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.

mapping.notes: A Gate-enters trigger with Ghostly Pilferer's verified 'This creature can't be blocked this turn.'; Jeskai Elder's combat-damage trigger, the draw mandatory. packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: gateway_sneak_gate_makes_it_unblockable, gateway_sneak_unblockable_only_this_turn.
